provenance.label: TESTNET: message semantics; latency is an indicative bound for mainnet, not a measurement of it

host_clock.source: logger clock_sync (5 samples of exchange server time vs the Mac clock); not NTP/chrony
host_clock.note: kept separate; raw cross-clock values are published next to the corrected ones

ack_rest_rtt_ms.definition: ack round trip: local send -> REST response, local monotonic clock only

ack_ws_new_local_ms.definition: local send -> private-stream 'New', local monotonic clock only

entry_half_rest_rtt_ms.definition: entry (arrival) estimate = REST round trip / 2, local clock only, assumes a symmetric path

entry_raw_ms.definition: entry (arrival): exchange create/new event time - local send wall time. RAW, includes the host clock offset

entry_offset_corrected_ms.definition: entry (arrival): raw minus the logger's clock-offset sample for this run segment (uncertainty ~85-100 ms)

report_delay_new_raw_ms.definition: private report delay for acks: local receipt - exchange event time (RAW, cross-clock)

report_delay_new_corrected_ms.definition: private report delay for acks, offset-corrected

report_delay_cancel_raw_ms.definition: private report delay for cancel reports: local receipt - exchange event time (RAW)

report_delay_cancel_corrected_ms.definition: private report delay for cancel reports, offset-corrected

cancel_rest_rtt_ms.definition: cancel round trip: cancel send -> REST response, local clock only

cancel_send_to_ws_cancelled_local_ms.definition: cancel send -> private-stream 'Cancelled', local clock only

cancel_arrival_raw_ms.definition: cancel arrival: exchange cancel event - local cancel send (RAW, cross-clock)

public_trade_print_comparison.note: same local clock for both receipts (offset-free). Matching on symbol+price+qty+exchange time within 250 ms; unmatched fills are counted

observation.note: used only to turn 'zero disconnects seen' into a rule-of-three rate bound: 3 / observation seconds

reject_probes.definition: orders priced to CROSS the book on purpose; they exist to capture the venue's reject message shape. The fraction rejected measures the probe, NOT a PostOnly reject rate
reject_probes.valid_probes_rejected_fraction_label: probe_cross_reject_fraction (designed-to-cross probes that were valid orders): NOT a PostOnly reject rate

natural_postonly.definition: fill_probe orders (PostOnly/GTX) priced to rest at or near the touch by the logger's own policy; a reject here is a real PostOnly would-cross event under that pricing
natural_postonly.by_hour_utc: withheld: cells with n < 30; the runs span a few hours (see inventory)
natural_postonly.caveat: orders were placed to rest; the strategy quotes at/near the touch, so the strategy's real PostOnly reject rate can be higher

cancel_fill_races_and_disconnects.note: counts only; a race is counted when an order that filled also carried a cancel request that did not succeed

ack_latency_proxy.definition: AckLatencySource-compatible block. grid 'testnet_half_rest_rtt' = entry arrival estimated as REST round trip / 2 (local clock only). The raw and offset-corrected one-way grids are in empirical_quantile_grids_by_network.
